facts.fact: 诺亚把第二个蹲占者摔在地上，落在一个扎黑色马尾的女孩旁边；两人双手被绑在背后、嘴被胶带封住。
facts.anchor: He landed hard beside the first, a girl with a greasy black ponytail

facts.fact: 伊莱在闯进商场、找到那两个青少年蹲占者之后，已经意识到他们的错误。
EON 的无人机探测到两个热源信号，这被当成要找的两个人。
facts.anchor: EON’s drone had picked up two heat signatures

facts.fact: 西德妮·克拉克掉进冰里之后，体温随之下降。
facts.anchor: But when Sydney Clarke had fallen through the ice, her temperature had fallen, too

facts.fact: 她的体温不像身体其他部分那样，一直没能完全回升。
facts.anchor: it had never fully come back up

facts.fact: 两辆面包车中有一辆停在商场外，另一辆和米奇·特纳一起留在汽车旅馆。
facts.anchor: the other back at the motel, with Mitchell Turner

facts.fact: 伊莱对诺亚说，三个人里只有他一辈子都在猎捕 EO。
facts.anchor: of the three of us, I’m the one who’s spent his whole life hunting EOs

facts.fact: 伊莱从诺亚腰上抽出猎刀，把刀刃抵在诺亚身侧护甲接缝最薄弱的地方。
facts.anchor: press the blade against the EO’s side, where the armor’s seam was weak enough to pierce

facts.fact: 伊莱想刺下去，手却不听使唤，被加百列的命令拦住。
facts.anchor: fingers trembling against the invisible, impassable weight of Gabriel’s orders

facts.fact: 伊莱把刀扔出去，说了一声“去捡”，刀扎进一块下坠的木招牌里。
facts.anchor: “Fetch,” he said, as it buried itself in a sagging wooden sign

facts.fact: 外面的探员在通讯里报告，只剩一个热源信号。
facts.anchor: We’ve got a single heat signature

facts.fact: 诺亚没有下命令，而是自己拔枪开了两枪，购物中庭响了两声。
facts.anchor: Two shots rang out in the food court

facts.fact: 探员说外面那个东西太冷，无法被识别为人类。
facts.anchor: but it’s too cold to register as human
